executiveSummary.narrative: Local agent assessment against APRF Core. Critical secrets control not demonstrated; gate cannot pass.

controls.title: Production secrets must live in a secrets manager and not in prompts, repos, or prod notebooks
requiredEvidenceMissing: Secrets-manager / sealed-secrets / cloud secret-ref wiring for production runtime
CI/repo secret-scan config covering prompts and fixtures
Latest secret-scan report with 0 privileged findings (measuredAt ≤90 days)
Attest or inventory showing 100% of production runtime secrets resolve from the secrets manager
controls.reasoning: Secrets-manager wiring covers production runtime secrets; 100% of those secrets resolve from the secrets manager; the latest secret scan covering repos, prompt registries, and client bundles finds 0 privileged production secrets (measuredAt ≤90 days). If no production runtime secrets exist, score NOT_APPLICABLE. Assessment: no secrets-manager wiring or measured secret-scan coverage observed in the assessed tree.
controls.recommendedAction: Move production secrets into a secrets manager (External Secrets, Vault, cloud SM, sealed-secrets, or equivalent) and wire runtime resolution; Add CI secret scanning covering prompts/fixtures; close privileged findings; Retain scored report under imports/secrets-hygiene/ (measuredAt ≤90 days); Time-box gaps with owner and expiry ≤90 days.

high.title: Secrets manager / scan evidence missing
high.summary: Cannot demonstrate SEC2-M1; treat as gate blocker until evidence exists.

quickWins.title: Enable gitleaks in CI
quickWins.summary: Add .github/workflows secret scan — low effort, high signal.

days30: Add secret scan CI and remove any plaintext credentials from the tree.
Document secrets manager wiring for production runtime.
days90: Extend scans to prompt registries and eval fixtures.
Automate detector IDs declared on SEC2-* Checks where possible.
longTerm: Adopt Regulated profile if tier-3 / regulated workloads are in scope.

disclaimer: Local APRF Auditor skill assessment — evidence-based self-attestation aid only. Not third-party certification. Not proof of NIST, ISO, or SOC 2 compliance.
